name: Run tests on save
description: Runs the relevant fast test suite when a source file is saved.

then.prompt: A file was saved. If it is under services/api, run `cd services/api && uv run pytest -q tests/unit tests/evals` (and the matching integration test if a router or migration changed). If it is under apps/web, run `pnpm --filter @complymate/web test`. Report failures with the file and line, and suggest a fix.
